wly.modmenu.title: World Loves You
wly.module.demo.desc: Demo module used only for framework self-check (prints one log line). No in-game effect.
wly.module.anvil-master.desc: Removes the anvil's 40-level "Too Expensive" cap (XP is still charged); shows enchantment levels in Roman numerals; /enchant-clear wipes every enchantment from the held item.
wly.module.anvil-no-limit.desc: The anvil no longer refuses to hand over the result because it is "Too Expensive": lifts the 40-level hard cap and the "cost pinned to 40 when the target item is stacked" clamp, and hides the "Too Expensive!" label. The cost is still charged (enable XP-Point Pricing to pay it in XP points).
wly.module.xp-points.desc: The anvil and the enchanting table stop charging experience LEVELS and charge experience POINTS instead: both the requirement and the deduction use the real point value on your XP bar (a cost of 30 now means 30 XP points, not 30 levels).
wly.module.anvil-repair.desc: Left-click an anvil while holding iron ingots to spend ingots and upgrade it one damage tier: damaged -> chipped -> anvil (one tier per click, 3 ingots per tier by default). Left-clicking an anvil while holding ingots never breaks it: a pristine anvil does nothing, and if you are short on ingots the action bar tells you how many are needed. With no ingots in hand the vanilla behaviour is kept (the anvil can be mined normally). Creative mode spends nothing.
wly.module.beacon-fill.desc: Right-click a beacon with mineral blocks to auto-fill its base (up to 4 layers); sneak + right-click to place the whole stack.
wly.module.big-stacks.desc: Raises the item stack limit from 64 to 999 (adjustable).
wly.module.clickthrough.desc: Right-clicking a sign continues the ray trace through it, hitting the block behind and triggering that block's own right-click action.
wly.module.climbing.desc: Adjustable climb speed multiplier (0-10, default 2); only vertical speed is boosted; looking down lets you slide faster.
wly.module.ctm.desc: Removes the top border from glass, stained glass and glass panes so adjacent glass looks seamless. Note: this is a static texture override that applies as soon as the mod is installed - the toggle is a marker only and cannot undo it in-game. Use the Resource Packs screen (then F3+T) to restore vanilla glass.
wly.module.eat-fast.desc: Eating speed multiplier: 1 = vanilla, 2 = twice as fast, 0 = instant (range 0-2).
wly.module.eat-full.desc: Keep eating even when the hunger bar is full; saturation can overflow (cap adjustable).
wly.module.elb.desc: Anvil combining no longer clamps enchantments to their max level; levels simply add up.
wly.module.emerald-lure.desc: Hold an emerald or emerald block and villagers within 8 blocks will follow (stopping at 2 blocks).
wly.module.enchant-reveal.desc: The enchanting table shows every potential enchantment for the item.
wly.module.enchant-tweak.desc: Lets normally exclusive enchantments coexist (the same enchantment is still rejected).
wly.module.eztweak-enderman-grief.desc: Endermen no longer pick up or place blocks.
wly.module.eztweak-ghast-no-grief.desc: Ghast fireballs no longer break blocks but still damage mobs.
wly.module.eztweak-farmland-protect.desc: Farmland is never trampled back into dirt.
wly.module.friendly-fire.desc: Pets are immune to damage from their owner and fellow pets; baby animals are immune to accidental hits (sneak to bypass).
wly.module.graves.desc: A grave spawns where a player dies, storing all items and experience; right-click to retrieve.
wly.module.harvest.desc: Right-click a mature crop to harvest and replant it and chain through nearby crops; bone meal chain-grows; seeds chain-plant.
wly.module.infinity-arrows.desc: Bows and crossbows with Infinity no longer consume any arrow type.
wly.module.maxhealth-fix.desc: Re-applies equipment max-health bonuses when re-entering a world, so the cap no longer collapses back to 20.
wly.module.mend-hold.desc: Shift + right-click spends your own experience to repair Mending items (main hand, then off hand, then armor).
wly.module.no-exp-warn.desc: Removes every warning screen for creating or loading experimental and customized worlds and proceeds directly.
wly.module.nonconflict-keys.desc: The key binds screen no longer shows the yellow conflict warning for duplicate keys.
wly.module.open-water.desc: A single water block is enough to fish up treasure loot.
wly.module.offline-catchup.desc: Catches up any period where real time passed but the world did not advance: re-entering after quitting, crashing or force-killing; returning to chunks that unloaded while you were away; pausing or minimising the game; the PC going to sleep; and skipping the night in a bed. Furnaces keep smelting, campfires keep cooking, crops keep growing and baby animals keep maturing.
wly.module.powershot.desc: Boosts the launch velocity of throwables (snowballs, eggs, potions, etc.) thrown by players and their pets, with optional bonus impact damage. Only applies to the player's side.
wly.module.rendi.desc: Removes invulnerability frames from every mob except players and their pets, so every hit of a combo deals full damage.
wly.module.reroll.desc: Sneak + right-click an enchanting table to spend experience and reroll the three enchantment options.
wly.module.ruler.desc: Locks game rules from config/minecraft_love_you/ruler.json, applied on server start and whenever a player joins.
wly.module.smart-tooltip.desc: Appends durability, stack limit and item id to item tooltips.
wly.module.smooth-bedrock.desc: Flattens the Overworld bedrock layer to a single layer (bedrock above the lowest level becomes deepslate).
wly.module.snow-cap.desc: During rain or snow, exposed blocks around the player accumulate snow layer by layer (up to 8 layers); warm biomes get no snow.
wly.module.sort.desc: Sorts the inventory and every chest into creative-inventory order with one key (default R).
wly.module.spawner-plus.desc: Right-click a spawner with a spawn egg to change its mob type; breaking a spawner drops the spawner itself.
wly.module.splash-milk.desc: Adds a throwable milk bottle that clears all status effects in an area on impact (crafted from a milk bucket and gunpowder).
wly.module.tame-safety.desc: Every 10 ticks, scans tamed mobs within 32 blocks and pulls them out of lava, fire, cacti, sweet berry bushes and wither roses, and teleports drowning pets to the surface.
wly.module.trade-display.desc: Hovering the villager trade button shows a full summary including enchantment details.
wly.module.trajectory.desc: While holding a bow (at current charge) / crossbow / trident / snowball / egg / ender pearl / potion / experience bottle, draws the predicted flight path and impact point with particles. Respects the Power Shot multiplier and works in both hands.
wly.module.vine-extend.desc: Holding weeping vines, twisting vines, vines or ladders, look up to place above and look down to place below.
wly.module.visible-traders.desc: Shows every villager trade in the trade screen; out-of-stock entries are no longer greyed out (display only, does not change what you can actually buy).
wly.config.about.desc: Config is saved to config/minecraft_love_you.json; changes take effect immediately. Key binds live in the vanilla "Key Binds" screen.
wly.config.powershot.velocity.tooltip: Throwable launch velocity multiplier (0-10): 0 = no strength at all, 1 = vanilla, 10 = ten times faster.
wly.config.powershot.damage.tooltip: When enabled, throwables damage mobs on impact and damage scales with launch velocity (range 0-50). Off by default.
wly.config.powershot.damage_max.tooltip: Maximum damage a throwable can deal (0-50). Actual damage = velocity x cap / 10.
wly.config.big_stacks.max_stack.tooltip: Maximum stack size (default 999; set 1 to restore vanilla).
wly.config.eat_full.saturation_cap.toolt: Highest saturation that can accumulate (0 - 2,100,000,000; default 100).
wly.config.harvest.chain_limit.tooltip: Maximum number of crops for chain harvesting and chain bone-mealing (default 64).
wly.config.harvest.same_species.tooltip: On = only the same crop chains; off = every crop chains.
wly.config.harvest.plant_limit.tooltip: Maximum number of empty farmland blocks chain-planted when right-clicking with seeds (default 64).
wly.config.eat_fast.speed.tooltip: 1 = vanilla speed; 2 = twice as fast; 0 = instant (range 0-2).
wly.config.climbing.speed.tooltip: 1 = vanilla speed; 2 = twice as fast; 0 = cannot climb at all (range 0-10, default 2).
wly.config.climbing.down_boost.tooltip: Slide down faster while climbing and looking at least 60 degrees downward.
wly.config.anvil_repair.cost.tooltip: Iron ingots spent to upgrade an anvil by one damage tier (damaged -> chipped -> anvil). Range 1-31, default 3. A whole vanilla anvil costs 3 iron blocks + 4 ingots = 31 ingots.
wly.config.infinity_arrows.free_arrow.to: When enabled, a bow or crossbow carrying Infinity can be drawn and fired even with zero arrows anywhere in the inventory (it shoots a plain arrow that is never taken from stock). When disabled, vanilla applies: at least one arrow is required.
wly.msg.anvil_master.no_enchant: The held item has no modded enchantments.
wly.msg.anvil_repair.done: Anvil repaired by one tier (%1$s iron ingots spent).
wly.msg.anvil_repair.not_enough: Not enough iron ingots (one tier needs %1$s).
wly.ui.reroll.tooltip: Click or press the configured Reroll key: spend experience to reroll the enchantment options.
wly.ui.grave.name: Grave
